objective: Select for project-owner review exactly two untouched Java and two untouched Ruby deployable-product source families by activating one frozen Java reserve nomination and performing one outcome-blind metadata-only search for one additional Java and two Ruby identities.

frozen_java_reserve_nomination.selection_basis: Previously frozen untouched Java reserve; no new metadata read is required unless its exact retained binding fails, in which case the gate stops rather than refreshing it.

metadata_discovery_contract.selection: After eligibility closes, order each language bucket by sha256('opt-010-java-ruby-augmentation-v1' + lowercase repository identity + exact commit). Select the first one eligible new Java identity and first two eligible new Ruby identities, then combine them with the fixed codelibs/fess reserve nomination in Java-first/Ruby-second stable-hash order.
metadata_discovery_contract.shortfall_rule: If one new Java and two new Ruby identities do not qualify exactly, persist only aggregate counts and shortfall by language; disclose no partial new identity list and leave the fixed reserve unactivated for acquisition.
metadata_discovery_contract.review_boundary: A complete result may disclose the four repository identities, exact commits, stable hashes, languages, licenses, README identities, and metadata-only selection bases to the project owner for review. It authorizes no acquisition or scanning.

stop_conditions: Any frozen input, reserve identity, store hash, branch, empty index, query, eligibility rule, selection rule, or initially absent output drifts.

Any query exceeds fifteen candidates or omits an exact age, maintenance, self-hosted, fork, archive, stars, or language qualifier; more than forty metadata reads would be required; or a nonallowed host is needed.
Fewer than exactly one new Java and two new Ruby identities qualify without relaxing a rule, any owner or repository family repeats, or any selected metadata or exact commit is missing or ambiguous.
Any source, security, outcome, scanner, provider, store, assessment, label, training, rescoring, review, acquisition, git-mutation, lifecycle, or unlisted-file activity would be required.
excluded: source acquisition, clone, archive, checkout, materialization, repository-code execution, code search, source access beyond README and license metadata, scanner, retrieval, architecture, provider, agentic, store, assessment, label, outcome, review, training, or rescoring activity
finding, candidate, score, rank, prediction, severity, confidence, packet, adequacy threshold, source-performance, or prior-agreement inspection or persistence
